title: Holy Trinity Cathedral, Karachi
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap Trinity Church envelope and projecting bell tower, way 687683620.
sectionBasis: Calan’s cleared circa-2002 photo controls the shortened crenellated clock tower and curved roof. The government inventory and heritage foundation confirm the building and 1904 tower reduction.
limitations: The model represents circa 2002 with the shortened tower and barrel roof. The chosen date is the archive’s approximate year, and rear openings and clock face detail are simplified.

The named mapped perimeter fixes the scale and tower placement. The approximately 35 m tower height and surviving tier proportions follow the exterior photograph and published descriptions. Side aisle and roof divisions are reconstructed.
Original elevation samples are retained. The south and north foundations and threshold placement follow approximate contact with the independent composite field.
